current.text: The Spurs signed Tobias Harris. That adds to an already deep forward and wing group with Devin Vassell, Julian Champagnie and Harrison Barnes.
He projects as about the eighth man in the rotation. He is not a starter but still ranks ahead of Harrison Barnes. The projected starters are Fox, Castle, Vassell, Harris and Wembanyama.
This is a contract year for him.
Tobias Harris, the likely starting forward, has a calf strain.
The Spurs are expected to trade away some of their forward depth in the relatively near future, but not right now.
The Spurs are pushing to win now and project as a top team in the West, with one prediction of 63 wins.

durable.text: He won Sixth Man of the Year.
He is not starting caliber. His numbers as a starter years ago were his ceiling.
His game is very similar to Saddiq Bey's.

note: At Yahoo rank 212 and ESPN rank 152, with a 0 USD value on both sites, he falls outside our 144-player draft pool. He should go undrafted. His projection of about 13 points and 5 rebounds in roughly 25 minutes has no category outlier. It brings few steals and blocks, offset by low turnovers and a decent FG% for a forward. Watch him on waivers early in the season if Tobias Harris's calf strain lingers or a Spurs trade clears forward minutes.
